===Olympic Games===
{{Main|Football at the Summer Olympics}}

[[File:Egypt-Turkey 1928 Summer Olympics.jpg|thumb|Turkey at the [[Football at the 1928 Summer Olympics|1928 Summer Olympics in Amsterdam]]]]

For [[Football at the 1968 Summer Olympics|1968]]–[[Football at the 1988 Summer Olympics|1988]] see [[Turkey national amateur football team|this page]]. Football at the Summer Olympics has been an under-23 tournament since 1992.

==Honours==
===Global===
* '''[[FIFA World Cup]]'''
** {{bronze3}} Third place (1): [[2002 FIFA World Cup|2002]]
* '''[[FIFA Confederations Cup]]'''
** {{bronze3}} Third place (1): [[2003 FIFA Confederations Cup|2003]]

===Continental===
*'''[[UEFA European Championship]]'''
** Semi-finalist: [[UEFA Euro 2008|2008]]{{Efn|Although there was no [[Third place playoff|third-place play-off]] match, UEFA decided to award the defeated semi-finalists of Euro 2008 with bronze medals.<ref>{{cite web |title=Regulations of the UEFA European Football Championship 2006/08 |url=https://www.uefa.com/newsfiles/19079.pdf |publisher=UEFA |access-date=13 October 2024 |location=2.08 |page=3 }}</ref>}}

===Regional===
* '''[[Balkan Cup]]'''
** Runners-up (1): [[1931 Balkan Cup|1931]]
* '''[[Mediterranean Cup (men's football)|Mediterranean Cup]]'''
** Runners-up (1): 1949
* '''[[Islamic Games]]'''
** Silver medal (1): [[Football at the Islamic Games|1980]]

===Friendly===
* '''[[ECO Cup]]'''
** '''Champions (3):''' 1967, 1969, 1974
** Runners-up (2): 1965, 1970

===Decoration===
In 2002, the national team was honored with the Turkish "[[State Medal of Distinguished Service]]" for their third place achievement at the [[2002 FIFA World Cup]]. All the team members, coaches and officials were given medals.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.tccb.gov.tr/ahmet-necdet-sezer-konusmalari/495/56762/a-milli-futbol-takimimiza-devlet-ustun-hizmet-madalyasi-verilmesi-toreni.html|title=Hata Sayfası|website=tccb.gov.tr|access-date=29 October 2016|archive-date=7 July 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150707080130/http://www.tccb.gov.tr/ahmet-necdet-sezer-konusmalari/495/56762/a-milli-futbol-takimimiza-devlet-ustun-hizmet-madalyasi-verilmesi-toreni.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
